No first purchase

Free stays free

A woman who loves your masterclass has two choices today: book a Deep Dive call, or leave. Most leave, and the trust you just built earns nothing.

No qualifier

Every call starts from zero

With nothing in between, the women on your calls have never bought from you before. A small first purchase shows you who is serious long before they book.

Content treadmill

1,264 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post, the next talk and the next guest spot. When you step back, the lead flow steps back too.

The high-performing women who love your masterclass but aren't ready for coaching today have nowhere to say a small yes, so most of them say nothing.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Nobody would guess"

Hook
"If people would describe you as confident, and nobody would guess how much you second-guess yourself, this is for you." (to camera, bright light, same feel as your profile photo)
Body
"I work with high-performing women every day, and the pattern is almost always the same. Brilliant at the job, generous with everyone else, and quietly hardest on themselves. The good news: that pattern can be noticed, and once you notice it, you can start to change it." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I put the first step into a 7-day program called The Unlock Reset. Tap Learn more to start today."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions before you say no to yourself"

Hook
"Before you talk yourself out of your next big step, ask these three questions." (Sarah holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: whose voice is this, mine or an old one? Two: what would I tell a friend in my position? Three: what's the smallest step I could take this week?" (caption for each question)
CTA
"There's a full lesson on this in The Unlock Reset. Link below."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where should I start?"

Hook
"Women ask me where to start if they're not ready for one-to-one coaching. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Start with seven days. One short lesson a day: notice the pattern, rewire the inner critic, redefine enough, back yourself, plan your next bold move, and make it stick. By day seven you'll know exactly what's been holding you back."
CTA
"It's called The Unlock Reset, and you can start today. Tap Learn more."
